stem:
Yash looks at the graph of a cycle journey. Before he reads any value or pattern, he must decide what each axis, scale, marker, and line represents.

Which claim correctly states that first step?

options.text: Read the horizontal axis as time in minutes and the vertical axis as distance in kilometres from the labelled scales, then read points.
Read a distance from a marker before the axis scales are identified.
Reading the plotted points is what creates the axis labels.
Apply a pie-slice legend rule to these line-graph axes.

teacher.key_rationale: Axis, scale, marker, and line meanings come before values. Skipping scale identification, reversing cause, or stretching a pie legend onto a line graph miss that reading order.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source distance-time graph as a simple line graph with time (min) and distance (km) axes and four marked points.
